recommendedTextbook.title: New School Physics for Senior Secondary Schools
recommendedTextbook.author: M.W. Anyakoha
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education & NERDC

topics.topic: Fundamental and Derived Quantities and Units
subtopics: SI units of fundamental quantities (length, mass, time, temperature, current)
Derived physical quantities and dimensional analysis
Measurement instruments: Vernier callipers and micrometer screw gauge
objectives: Identify the 7 fundamental SI base units
Determine dimensions of force, pressure, work, and power
Read Vernier calipers and micrometer gauges with precision

subtopics: Frame of reference and coordinates in 2D space
Resolution of vectors into rectangular components
objectives: Distinguish scalar distance from vector displacement
Calculate resultant vectors using parallelogram law
Resolve inclined forces into horizontal and vertical components

topics.topic: Rectilinear Motion: Speed, Velocity and Acceleration
subtopics: Equations of uniformly accelerated motion: v = u + at, s = ut + 0.5at², v² = u² + 2as
objectives: Derive the three fundamental equations of motion
Calculate distance traveled from area under a velocity-time graph

topics.topic: Position, Distance, Displacement and Motion Kinematics
subtopics: Scalar and vector quantities: Definition, notation, and vector resolution
Rectilinear motion parameters: Speed, velocity, uniform acceleration, and deceleration
Derivation and graphical analysis of the three equations of uniformly accelerated motion
objectives: Resolve coplanar vector systems using parallelogram and trigonometric methods.
Derive the 3 fundamental kinematics equations from first velocity-time graphical principles.
Solve 5 multi-step WAEC standard numerical problems on motion under gravity.
